description: A value written with brackets inside an INSERT's VALUES row, as ARRAY[1, 2], ARRAY[1, 2] || ARRAY[3] or ARRAY[(6), 7], or inside an UPDATE's row assignment SET (scores, label, flagged) = (ARRAY[8, 9], $1, $2), is one value: the parameters after it take the columns at their own positions, label as string and flagged as bool, in one row and in a second row, and the server stores them there. Through database/sql.
